title: Fix saving a profile photo (the photos table was never made)
notes: The deploy's database step sent schema.sql as an import, which the Cloudflare token isn't allowed to do, so the new photos table was never created. It now runs as a query, and the Worker also makes the photos table itself the first time it's needed.

title: The Contact page's touches across the site

title: Profile photos for accounts
notes: Choose a photo on the Account page, move and scale it in a circle, and a small square JPEG is kept in the accounts database (photos table) and served from /photo/<id>. The server checks each photo's real type from its first bytes and its size (150 KB). Remove goes back to your initial. A new photo or name now reaches other devices on sync. Introduces itself once with the shared feature tip.

title: Audit after the move: fix the hourly build, watchdog, alerts and Cloudflare serving
changes: Temporary audit checks of the live site
Temporary audit checks, round 2
Temporary: try the new watchdog checks
Audit after the move: fix the hourly build, watchdog, alerts and Cloudflare serving (2.50.6)

The hourly build, its freshness gate, the watchdog and the alerts Worker read the live data from the site's workers.dev address: tenner.stream's bot check turned them away, so chart movement reset every hour, New This Week and the rent/buy prices were wiped, every title was re-fetched hourly and the watchdog raised false alarms
GitHub Pages is no longer built or deployed (a second copy at github.io); Cloudflare deploys queue one at a time
Keep-alive for the schedules runs on every run, not only scheduled ones
.html links are served straight away instead of redirected (faster taps, and the installed app opens pages offline)
A 404 page: a shared link to a title that has left Tenner's lists still opens it
Browsers keep scripts, styles, fonts and icons instead of re-checking them on every page
The search Worker no longer accepts the old github.io addresses
The watchdog also checks www.tenner.stream and New This Week, and still checks the domain's renewal after a failure

title: Serve tenner.stream from Cloudflare instead of GitHub Pages
notes: GitHub Pages keeps tenner.stream tied to the old, lost account, so the hourly build now also deploys site/ as static files on a Cloudflare Worker (tenner-site) at tenner.stream, with tenner-www sending www.tenner.stream on to it. If the domain can't be connected yet, the site still goes up on workers.dev and the run says which DNS records to delete.

title: Point repo references at the new danxharvard/tenner account
notes: Adds danxharvard.github.io to the worker's allowed origins (keeping the old one while the live site still serves from it), and updates the Mac app clone/download links and Wikidata user-agent strings.

title: Title links find more titles and look after themselves
changes: Wikidata is now searched by each title's IMDb ID as well as its TMDB ID (TMDB gives both in the same request), so titles whose Wikidata entry lacks a TMDB ID still open on the service itself
Malformed IDs on Wikidata are skipped at build time, so a good ID listed after a bad one is used instead of falling back to search; the search service does the same
The longest-unchecked titles are looked up first, in smaller batches with one more retry
Titles.json records when Wikidata last answered and how many places to stream open the title directly; the hourly notice reports both
The watchdog re-runs the hourly job if Wikidata hasn't answered for 48 hours or fewer than half the titles have a direct link

Opening one swings it on its hinge with a burst of gold sparkles, and the pick comes forward on a card: mostly Christmas favourites (found in this hour's catalogue or by the search service), sometimes something popular we think you'll enjoy, picked at random and kept on this device. Where to watch opens its sheet; the round button adds it to the Watchlist. Closing the calendar shrinks it into its new box at the top of the right-hand column, above Discover, which shows today's door from then on. Plays unless the device asks for Reduce Motion.

While it shows, the page fades to a winter night (a pale winter morning by day) and snow falls from the top of the window; it all goes back when another title comes round. On phones it's a card above the charts, snowing while it's in view. No snow with Reduce Motion. Introduces itself once with the shared feature tip.

title: Bug hunt and polish: a loading ring on computers, safer streaming links, new climbing badges and 20 fixes
changes: Loading ring (computers only). Ten bars in Tenner's colours with a light running round them, in a frosted square in the middle of the page. It only appears if a page or its charts take more than a moment (about a third of a second), stays long enough not to flicker, and never shows on phones. With Animations on, the ring also turns slowly and springs in. With them off, only the light moves.

Climbing badges. "Climbing this week" and New's "Biggest Climbers" now show a green badge like Apple's Stocks app: a round arrow lit from above, then the number of places. The line under each title now reads "Now No. 2 on Netflix", so the number isn't repeated.

Each title's own ID from Wikidata (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, HBO Max, Apple TV) is now checked against the shape that service's addresses take before it's used. An old or mistyped ID used to open a broken page. Now it falls back to that service's search, with the title filled in.
Services TMDB lists under other names now get the right button and link instead of TMDB's page. This covers Max, HBO Max Free, Channel 5, My5, ITV Hub, ITVX Premium, U and Rakuten.
A chart's own Netflix link is checked before the Watch button uses it.
A title's sheet said "1 seasons" when the season count came from TMDB.
"1 episodes to go" now reads "1 episode to go", and "0 episodes to go" no longer appears.
Button icons that pages hadn't sized were invisible. Every button now shows its icon, as the house style requires.
The empty Watchlist's and New's "See the top 10" bounced through a redirect. It now goes straight to Home and has an icon.
Discover's "You've seen them all" card had a double space and a Watchlist button that wasn't in the house style.
New's phone banners could say "undefined original".
Browse redrew For You twice every time a sheet closed, which lost your place in the row.
A catalogue title with no release date could break Browse's Newest and Oldest sorts and the years filter.
The Home page asked for a haptic buzz that didn't exist. Saving and picking services now give a small buzz on phones that support it.
Account: the colour swatches were read out as "Colour 210". They're now called Blue, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange, Green and Teal.
Account: if a content blocker stops Google's sign-in script, the page no longer fails. The Google button just stays hidden.
"What should I watch tonight?": a failed load is now tried again next time instead of being remembered, and its buttons have icons.
A feature tip you've seen in one tab now stays seen in your other open tabs.
Privacy & Terms used to mark all three menu links (Terms, Privacy, Cookies) as the current page at once. Now only the part you're reading is marked, and the mark follows you as you scroll.
Very small placeholder posters (in the Top 10 box and Climbing) showed clipped letters. They now show just their colours.
notes: Also tidied: unused code removed (the old arrow icon and its styles, and some empty lines).

changes: Keep Tenner updating itself while nobody's around

Update.yml is asked three times an hour; a scheduled try that finds the live chart under 40 minutes old stops at once. Only the deploy job queues on `pages`, so a spare try can never cancel a push waiting to go live.
The watchdog runs hourly (charts flagged after two hours, not two and a half), and fails a fortnight before tenner.stream's registration runs out.
Tenner TV gets a second scheduled try 90 minutes after each one, and fails a fortnight before the Cloudflare token's end date, if it has one.

Search moves to the left, under the menu button. Discover's round buttons take Tenner's round button style, and Help me choose gets an icon. Tenner 2.25.0.
